data.name: Sharanshwa
data.gender_notes: Sharanshwa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharanshwa is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Shara’ which means ‘path’ and ‘Ansh’ which means ‘protector’. This name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to be the protector and guide on the path of life. The name Sharanshwa carries the meaning “Protector of the Path” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharanshwa usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the path and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the divine presence of a guardian angel or a guru, guiding one through the journey of life.
data.etymology: Sharanshwa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Path.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharanshwa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
